objectivePolicy.normalization: NONE; do not coerce label/letter/index/string-number; validate assigned option membership first
objectivePolicy.correctRule: Exact match to approved proposedCorrectOptionId from pinned private key set
objectivePolicy.answeredRule: One structurally valid assigned choice per objective item, whether correct or wrong
objectivePolicy.denominatorRule: Freeze approved eligible assigned IDs at allocation: grammar6,vocabulary6,reading5,listening5,familiarity5 for a complete form; never shrink after answers/key failures
objectivePolicy.percentageRule: round(100*correct/eligible), display numerator/denominator; no cross-form calibration
objectivePolicy.unansweredPolicy: PROPOSED_PENDING_OWNER: explicit final incomplete-answer confirmation; unanswered counts0 correct and remains in denominator
objectivePolicy.invalidSourcePolicy: Missing/invalid required key, digest, owner or audio verification -> unavailable/invalid result, not0%; no silent dropping or current-key substitution
objectivePolicy.zeroPolicy: AVAILABLE/0 only for genuine all-wrong valid submitted dimension; zero eligible is UNSUPPORTED/null

capturePolicy.writing: Preserve private raw text and responseId; nonblank counts presence independently of180-word target; count trim/split whitespace for display only
capturePolicy.speaking: Explicit RECORDED_SESSION_ONLY/RECORDED_PERSISTED/NO_MIC_FALLBACK/UNKNOWN_LEGACY; valid session/media evidence and finalized usable blob required for provided; duration alone insufficient
capturePolicy.persistence: Session-only evidence becomes unavailable after session loss; no claim of stored audio without durable owned reference and retention approval
capturePolicy.analytics: Never store response text, audio, credentials or private media URLs in activity events

forbiddenOutputs: Trend/proficiency growth from different or repeated forms
